patches.name: Lyrics in player
patches.description: Shows the line of the lyrics that is sung between the cover and the title in the player. Requires the Third-party lyrics patch.

patches.name: Origin Island music card
patches.description: Lets the OriginOS music card on the lock screen and Origin Island like songs, switch between repeat and shuffle, show the playlist, the playlists of the library and the downloads, and show the lyrics of the Third-party lyrics patch.

patches.name: Pause on fold
patches.description: Pauses what plays when a foldable phone is closed.

patches.name: Comments under the video
patches.description: Shows the comments under the video in the wide layout, as on an opened foldable phone held sideways, instead of over the suggested videos.

patches.name: Origin Island music card
patches.description: Lets the OriginOS music card on the lock screen and Origin Island like videos, show the captions of a video as its lyrics, and show what plays next as the playlist.

patches.name: Pause on fold
patches.description: Pauses what plays when a foldable phone is closed.

patches.name: Origin Island music card
patches.description: Lets the OriginOS music card on the lock screen and Origin Island show lyrics, like songs, switch between repeat and shuffle, and show the playlist and play from it.
